recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,514.30 (+1.14%) and the Sensex at 83,021.75 (+1.21%); Bank Nifty moved +1.65%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +1.22%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +1.00%, small caps (Smallcap 250) +0.77%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹7,411 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹1,357 cr (provisional, NSE).
Auto led the sectors (+4.40%), while IT lagged (-1.10%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Voltas (+9.03%); biggest faller was One 97 Communications (-8.68%). Breadth: 352 advances vs 146 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.40% and the Nasdaq down 0.03%.
The rupee is at 93.28 per dollar, Brent at $89.78 (-2.36%) and gold at $3,686 (-1.51%).
